linkedin.title: Most news apps are designed to make you scroll faster, not think deeper.
linkedin.body:
We have all been there. You open a news app, scan a dozen headlines, and close it feeling like you know less than when you started. The constant stream of breaking updates creates noise, but it rarely builds understanding.

That is why we built Deep Dive Mode for Headlinne. Instead of just giving you another list of links, it connects the dots for you. It takes a complex story and breaks down the context, the history, and the implications in plain language.

Understanding the news should not feel like a chore. You should not have to open ten browser tabs just to figure out why a specific policy change actually matters to your daily life.

We believe technology should do the heavy lifting of synthesis so you can focus on the actual substance of the story. It is about moving from being informed to being truly knowledgeable.

instagram.caption:
A projectile hit a passenger terminal at King Khalid airport in Riyadh this past Sunday.

This follows a missile attack the day before, marking a dangerous new phase in the ongoing conflict.

International reports confirm one death, though outlet estimates on the number of injuries differ significantly. This uncertainty highlights how chaotic the situation on the ground has become.

Analysts warn that this escalation will force major international players to rethink their current strategies in the region. The risk of the conflict widening is now a primary concern for global security experts.
